factual_fidelity.evidence: Matches inputs: '180 square meters', '3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms', 'Cloche d'Or district', 'elevator', 'parking', 'cellar'.

completeness.evidence: Covers sqm, beds/baths, neighborhood, new-build, terrace, double-height living, Siemens kitchen, oak flooring, park view, elevator, parking, cellar, evening sun.

native_quality.evidence: Reads as native English: 'The residence benefits from an elevator-accessible building with secured parking and a cellar for additional storage.'

market_fit.evidence: Uses 'duplex apartment', 'engineered oak flooring', 'quartz worktops', 'soft-close cabinetry' — appropriate luxury portal English.

compliance_cpe.evidence: No CPE class in inputs and prose correctly omits any energy class reference.

seo_signal.evidence: Title 'Contemporary 3-Bedroom Duplex with Panoramic City and Park Views in Cloche d'Or' is 12 words and well-shaped; 5 CamelCase hashtags including 'ClocheDOr'.

tone_discipline.evidence: No hyperbole or exclamation marks; descriptors like 'voluminous' and 'expansive' are restrained and photo-supported.

fair_housing.evidence: No demographic references — 'Prospective buyers will appreciate its position' is neutral.

hallucination.evidence: Unsupported: 1. 'secured parking' adds 'secured' which is not in the inputs (parking is listed as true but no security attribute). All other claims supported.

cross_lang_consistency.evidence: All three languages agree on 180 m², 3 beds, 2 baths, sale, parking, cellar, elevator, terrace. FR adds 'dressing intégré' on the master where DE/EN say 'fitted wardrobes' — a minor non-contradictory detail.
